title: Exploring Interactions and Regulations in Collaborative Learning: An Interdisciplinary Multimodal Dataset
reasoning: The paper introduces a novel multimodal dataset to study interactions and regulations in collaborative learning, focusing on emotional and cognitive processes. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics. The ethical considerations mentioned pertain to data collection consent (GDPR), which is standard practice for research involving human participants, and not a core component of the study's evaluation or benchmarking of faith/ethics.
